about: COS's pipeline module: the box shape, the gates, and every request kept as files until its contract is met (PC1, PC5; cos/spec/pipeline-canvas.spec)
origin: James, 2026-11-09: "No. Terrible folder structure. This needs to be a module." · "Needs to use actual physical files in the backend, the steps. Like the dag and contract, and the relevant nodes. Like each step needs to be persistent until the contract and conditions for the request from the dag have been met." · "The gates are temporary unless it didn't finish."

components.does: a request kept as files: request, on_event, gate_context, gate_verdict, record_actions, list_requests, read_request, resume_of

a .framework that declares its steps (schema.process, schema.process_step) compiles to a .pipeline, with every framework its steps run (any depth, children first); a loop, a missing one, or one that only describes is refused, named; the engine's framework step runs it
the module's one command line: boxes, dag, erv, roundtrip, types, save-type, gate, gate-actions, request, event, list, read, resume-of

components.door: starts Emerge (until COS's manager is Emerge, CIE13), makes the HTTP calls a gate asks for (no sockets in Emerge until CIE10), takes the engine's events in order; no logic

gives: the engine's gateFn: a typed gate's verdict

extensions.is: one kind of gate: what decides (checks), what it asks its owners first (asks), what it holds, what it does on open, closed or gap
a request through a pipeline and where it stands (its contract is contract.contract, a real .contract node)
a request's DAG: each step and, after a gated step, its gate, wired
extensions.schema: node envelope, type dag: { boxes: Box[], wires: Wire[] }

extensions.is: one step of a request: what it runs, what it waits on, its conditions, status, output, every verdict, what its gate learned; kept until met
a gate for one request: its type, settings, what it holds, its verdicts; removed when the request is met, kept when it is not
the request's contract: RAID's executable .contract v2, booked with Cortex by route (one task gate per step, passing on step:<id> evidence); COS keeps only its id and the verdict

nodes.about: what a request carries: each step's output as a node of its type in nodes/<step>/out.<type>; a step declares takes/gives (lib/node-schemas: chunk, contract, context, gap, intent, hypothesis, crystal, output … any of them); each wire in dag.dag says what it carries; each step file names what it took and gave
nodes.origin: James, 2026-11-09: "i meant the data that runs through the pipeline like idearium pipeline does, emerge, .contracts with .dag, .chunk, .context or any of the nodes." · "look at the idearium pipeline, don't limit to just my request for the node types"
nodes.types: every type in lib/node-schemas (77 with .context and .dag, added 2026-11-09)

recursive: a step that runs a pipeline (or a framework, compiled to one) starts a child request; the step names its children, the child its parent (request, step), at any depth (the engine's chain and MAX_DEPTH)
gives_the_engine: frameworkFn (a framework step: compile the tree, name the pipeline)
